notes: TROOP 0.4.6 fixes the major online-entry stalls with staged loading, shared graphics shaders and terrain collisions that no longer wait for GPU readbacks. Connections can be canceled and retried safely. Existing 0.4.5 installations receive this compatible content update automatically and apply it on restart. The very first join with a fresh graphics cache can still briefly pause for shader compilation. Multiplayer remains protocol 11.
